## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change and link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] I verified affected UI behavior against a local `amuleapi` instance, when applicable.

## Review notes

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, local `.env` values, or aMule runtime data are included.
- [ ] API changes follow `docs/api/REFERENCE.md` and preserve cookie-based authentication.
- [ ] Destructive actions have clear confirmation and feedback.
- [ ] I included screenshots or a short recording for visible UI changes, when useful.
